name: THAD'S HOTEL ROOM
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE BED
LOOK_AT: A bed with a valley in it, shaped by predecessors. I sleep on one slope or the other.
A bed, made, narrow, and the sheets are clean. I had not expected the sheets to be clean.
It is the only thing in Consolation that has exceeded my expectations.
Five dollars a week. I have decided the sheets are most of it.
LISTEN_TO: Springs. They report every intention before I have finished forming it.
Nothing.
Nothing.
Nothing. It is a bed and it is waiting, which is what they do.

overrides.USE: It is nine in the morning.
overrides.PUSH: I moved it off the valley. I woke in the valley. The bed and the floor have seniority.

subjects.name: THE WASHSTAND
LOOK_AT: A basin, a pitcher, and a bar of soap worn to a wafer. Washing in the territory is devotional: brief, and mostly symbolic.
A washstand, a jug, a basin, and a piece of mirror the size of my hand.
The water is brought up cold at six and is cold at six.
I have shaved in a piece of mirror the size of my hand every day for eleven weeks and I am beginning to take a view about it.
LISTEN_TO: A drip that keeps no rhythm. I have tried tuning it. It resists.
Nothing. Water, when I move it.
Nothing.
Nothing.

overrides.USE: I muffled it with a sock. It transposed. The drip has range.

subjects.name: THE WINDOW
LOOK_AT: The alley. A cat, some barrels, and a view of the back of the Improvement Company.
The alley. A cat, some barrels, and the back of the Improvement Company.
One story, from here. From the street it is three. I have checked from both.
LISTEN_TO: The town. All of it. The wall between us is a formality.
Somebody unloading, two streets over. It goes on all night. I have stopped minding it, which worries me.
The cat is on the barrels again. She gets up there and then reconsiders.
Nothing. Whoever was unloading has stopped, and the quiet is worse.

LOOK_AT: The alley. The cat has gone. The barrels are the same.

subjects.name: THE DESK
LOOK_AT: One short leg, corrected with a folded claim notice. The most useful work a claim notice has done all year.
A desk, a chair, and a window facing an alley. For five dollars a week, I had expected a slightly worse alley.
The chair does not match the desk. Neither matches the room.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. The drama is all in what gets written at it.
Nothing. It is the only place in Consolation where nobody is talking.
Nothing.

subjects.name: THE LETTERS HOME
LOOK_AT: My letters, in draft. True in the way maps are true — accurate about everything except how it feels to stand here.
A sheet, begun. 'Dear Mother —' and then a space where the rest of it should be.
I have started it four times. The four beginnings are identical.
It goes out Thursday, with whatever is on it by Thursday.
LISTEN_TO: Paper. It holds whatever you tell it. That is the entire trouble with paper.
Nothing.
Nothing. It has not been written yet and it is being quiet about that too.

subjects.name: THE WARDROBE
LOOK_AT: A wardrobe for a man with wardrobe ambitions. My second shirt hangs in it with room to spread out.
The bottom drawer sticks. I have nothing to put in it, so we have come to an accommodation.
Somebody left a single glove on the top shelf. Nobody in Consolation owns gloves, so it was a visitor, and he lost the other one too.
LISTEN_TO: Empty hangers, touching. A small cold applause.
The door drifting on its hinge, a long, thin creak.
Nothing. My second shirt has nothing to say for itself.

overrides.CLOSE: The door drifts open again in the night, at the same slow speed each time, like it's checking on me.

subjects.name: THE LAMP
LOOK_AT: Trimmed low by management. Light is billed separately in spirit, if not on paper.
A notice is tacked beside it: GUESTS WILL KINDLY NOT TURN UP THE WICK. Kindly is underlined.
I turned it up a quarter inch. Nobody came. I turned it back down anyway.
LISTEN_TO: The flame eats quietly. Good manners, in a fire.
A small flutter when the door opens. It does not like visitors either.
Nothing. It burns at the volume management prefers.

overrides.TALK_TO: I bade it goodnight. Management's wick allowance ended the conversation on its side.

subjects.name: THE FLOORBOARDS
LOOK_AT: Gaps generous enough to bank coins in, which I would consider if I had coins to a degree worth hiding.
One board is newer than the others, and nailed down harder.
At night the lobby lamp shines up through the gaps, and the floor glows in stripes, like a cell, or a keyboard.
LISTEN_TO: The lobby, in outline. Mostly the bell.
The clerk below, turning a page.
Somebody crossing the lobby slowly and stopping at the foot of the stairs. Then going on.

overrides.PULL: The gap by the window lifts. Beneath: dust, a button, and one playing card. The eight of diamonds. Some other tenant's whole story, in three items.

subjects.name: THE DOOR
LOOK_AT: The lock takes the key, considers it, and admits anyone regardless. It is ceremonial, like most security.
The door down to the lobby. Number nineteen, in brass, hung slightly crooked.
Nineteen. The nine has been on and off more than once.
It locks. It is the only door I have ever had that locks and I do not lock it.
LISTEN_TO: The hallway. A man passes twice an hour, slower each time.
The lobby. A clock, and somebody on the landing.
Still the clock.
Nothing.

subjects.name: HIS MOTHER'S LETTERS
LOOK_AT: Three from home. She is proud of me. She has been given no reason to be.
She asks about the weather here as though it were a place that has weather.
The most recent is six weeks old. It went to Sacramento and waited for me there.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. Paper is very quiet about this sort of thing.
Nothing.
Nothing. Three letters, and not one of them has asked me anything I would have to answer.

LOOK_AT: Four from home. She has told the neighbours. The neighbours are also proud of me.
Five from home. She asks whether I am eating.
Six. I am going to answer this one properly.

overrides.PICK_UP: I have them. I have had them since Sacramento.

subjects.name: THE TUNING FORK CASE
LOOK_AT: Velvet-lined, and worth more than the fork. My father's idea of a sensible investment.
Velvet-lined, and worth more than the fork it was made for.
It is the most cared-for object I own and it is a box.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing, closed. It is a very good case.
Nothing, closed.
Nothing.

subjects.name: THE COAT ON THE DOOR
LOOK_AT: My good coat. It is the only thing I own that suggests I was once somebody's son with prospects.
My good coat. The only thing I own that suggests I was once somebody's son with prospects.
It has mud to the knee and I have stopped attending to it.
Providence made this coat for a man walking to an office.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing.
Nothing.
Nothing.

LOOK_AT: My good coat. It has been in a grave.

overrides.PICK_UP: I am wearing the other one, which is this one.

subjects.name: THE WALL
LOOK_AT: Boards, papered once, and the paper has given up in two corners.
Somebody before me wrote a number on the wall beside the bed and crossed it out.
The number was two hundred. I have not worked out what it was counting and I have stopped trying.
LISTEN_TO: Two men, next door, discussing where Mott's strike is. They are very sure. They are sure in completely different directions.
Two men next door, discussing where Mott's strike is. They are very sure, and sure in completely different directions.
Still sure. Still different.
One of them has gone to sleep mid-sentence. The other has not noticed.

overrides.PUSH: It gives. I am going to stop pushing it.
